paths.description: Homepage and search/recommendation entry template; represents global chrome and discovery.
Category listing template; represents browsing and repeated book cards.
Book detail and chapter-index template; represents content detail and entry to reading.
Chapter reading template and previous/next journey.

findings.summary: The site forces a light palette under the user’s dark preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot is pixel-identical to the default screenshot, and the CSS signal probe found no color-scheme, prefers-color-scheme, or light-dark() usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide dark surface/text tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Autoplay motion has no reduced-motion override.
findings.evidence: Rendered DOM shows TouchSlide autoPlay:true, a 1s translated carousel, and a repeating jQuery interval; the preference probe confirms reduce is active while CSS contains no reduced-motion rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable autoplay and non-essential transitions inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, while retaining manual controls.

findings.summary: The fixed palette does not adapt to increased-contrast or forced-colors preferences.
findings.evidence: The preference probe matched prefers-contrast: more, but CSS inspection found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors handling; Lighthouse also found low-contrast text.
findings.suggestedFix: Use system colors in forced-colors and strengthen colors under prefers-contrast.

findings.summary: Navigation swaps pages abruptly without View Transitions.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection across the MPA found no view-transition-name or @view-transition rule on the browse-to-book-to-chapter journey.
findings.suggestedFix: Add cross-document View Transitions with a no-motion fallback for navigation continuity.

findings.summary: Scroll behavior is driven by a continuous JavaScript scroll handler.
findings.evidence: Rendered source binds $(window).scroll(...) and jQuery animate() for the back-to-top behavior; CSS inspection found no scroll-driven timeline.
findings.suggestedFix: Prefer CSS scroll-state/scroll-driven behavior or an IntersectionObserver rather than continuous scroll work.

findings.summary: The carousel is a custom autoplaying jQuery/TouchSlide transform with weak platform semantics.
findings.evidence: Rendered DOM shows TouchSlide autoPlay:true, cloned slides, fixed 1000ms transforms, and numeric li indicators rather than native snap controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Use an overflow carousel with scroll-snap, semantic controls, and reduced-motion support.

findings.summary: Scroll-aware chrome is implemented with imperative toggling rather than declarative state.
findings.evidence: The source runs a window scroll callback on every scroll to show/hide #gotop2; no scroll-state query or progress affordance exists on long 13,795px chapter pages.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state/container queries where available and expose a lightweight reading-progress or back-to-top control.

findings.summary: The mobile navigation drawer uses an inaccessible span and custom div rather than a semantic control/overlay.
findings.evidence: DOM shows #simple-menu is a span with no role, name, or keyboard semantics, controlling a cloned #sidr-right div; there is no dialog or popover.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a named button and a dialog/popover with declarative dismiss and managed focus.

findings.summary: Components rely only on page-level responsive CSS, with no container-aware adaptation.
findings.evidence: CSS signal inspection across loaded stylesheets found no @container or container-type usage, despite reused book cards in listing and recommendation layouts.
findings.suggestedFix: Add container queries to reusable card/list components and retain viewport fallbacks.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and the menu trigger are not usable across input modalities.
findings.evidence: Focusing the first link produced outline-style none; the menu trigger is a non-focusable span. Lighthouse also reports unnamed interactive links.
findings.suggestedFix: Use semantic buttons/links, visible :focus-visible styles, and at least 44px touch targets.

findings.summary: Failure recovery is a raw server dead end.
findings.evidence: A representative missing URL displays only “404 Not Found / nginx” with no site navigation, search, explanation, or recovery action.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a branded 404 with search, home/category links, and preserved site navigation.

findings.summary: Measured layout stability misses the good Core Web Vitals range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured CLS 0.187, while LCP was 1.7s and TBT 0ms; CLS above 0.1 is not in the good range.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve all image/banner dimensions and identify the Lighthouse shift sources.

findings.summary: Images do not reserve intrinsic space.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found all 13 homepage images missing width and height attributes; Lighthouse measured CLS 0.187.
findings.suggestedFix: Set width/height or aspect-ratio for every image and carousel slot.

findings.summary: Legacy parser-blocking scripts delay delivery unnecessarily.
findings.evidence: HAR plus DOM confirmation found three synchronous scripts in head (jquery1.42, TouchSlide, jquery.lazyload) without async, defer, or module semantics.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unnecessary libraries and defer remaining non-critical scripts; keep critical CSS small.

findings.summary: The page ships duplicated legacy jQuery and disproportionate third-party JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Rendered DOM loads jquery1.42 and jquery1.69 plus plugins; HAR shows 213KB script transfer and the 143KB Grow script as the largest request.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate to no dependency or one current library and load optional third parties only after user value/consent.

findings.summary: Important images and interactive links lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: Images audit found 7 missing alt attributes; Lighthouse failed image-alt and link-name, and the DOM probe found 6 empty links.
findings.suggestedFix: Give functional images/links accessible names, use alt="" for decorative images, and make the menu a named button.

findings.summary: Secondary text and links fail minimum contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 2.84:1 for #999 text on #fffffc and also found footer links distinguished only by insufficient color difference.
findings.suggestedFix: Use text colors meeting 4.5:1 and underline inline links rather than relying only on color.

findings.summary: Heading structure, landmarks, and focus visibility are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found an H1-to-H3 heading-order failure and no main landmark; focus probing showed outline-style none.
findings.suggestedFix: Use sequential headings, one main landmark, and clear :focus-visible styles; manage focus for the drawer.

findings.summary: Asset markup is unsound despite a valid doctype and charset.
findings.evidence: DOM confirms HTML doctype/UTF-8, but all 13 audited images omit dimensions and all are legacy JPG; Lighthouse also reports a low-resolution search icon.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic dimensions, correct responsive sources, and modern formats while preserving aspect ratio.

findings.summary: The page loads multiple obsolete jQuery 1.x builds and legacy plugins.
findings.evidence: Rendered source confirms jquery1.42.min.js and jquery1.69.js on the same page, plus old TouchSlide/sidr/lazyload plugins, although Lighthouse saw no runtime deprecations or console errors.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicate/stale libraries and replace plugin behavior with maintained platform features.

findings.summary: Some interactive links are not crawlable or descriptive.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed crawlable-anchors for javascript:void(0), and found unnamed # carousel/history links; DOM shows many empty href="#" links.
findings.suggestedFix: Use buttons for actions and real descriptive href destinations for navigation.

findings.summary: Canonical and sitemap signals are inconsistent or missing.
findings.evidence: The homepage has no canonical; the HTTPS chapter declares an HTTP canonical; /sitemap.xml returns 404, while robots.txt contains only User-agent: * and pages otherwise return 200.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish HTTPS self-canonicals, a sitemap, and consistent robots/indexing signals.

findings.summary: Book and chapter entities lack structured and social metadata.
findings.evidence: DOM probes found zero JSON-LD and zero Open Graph tags on homepage/chapter despite visible book/chapter entities.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Book/CreativeWork JSON-LD and Open Graph metadata matching visible content.

findings.summary: Core browser security headers are missing.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence confirms HTTPS and HSTS but no CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, clickjacking protection, or Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy an enforcing CSP, nosniff, frame-ancestors (or X-Frame-Options), and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: A simple reading page contacts seven third-party origins.
findings.evidence: Tracker/HAR evidence records 16 third-party requests and 239KB transferred, including Grow and Skimresources; this is 39% of total transfer. No cookies were set on initial load.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit necessity, defer optional integrations, document them, and gate tracking behind an appropriate consent choice.

findings.summary: Clickjacking and browser policy defenses are absent.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence shows no CSP frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options, no Permissions-Policy, and no X-Content-Type-Options; Referrer-Policy and HSTS are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add frame-ancestors, nosniff, and a restrictive Permissions-Policy; consider Trusted Types when tightening CSP.

findings.summary: HTTP failures have no intentional recovery state.
findings.evidence: The tested 404 route is a bare nginx response with no navigation, retry, search, or explanation.
findings.suggestedFix: Route HTTP errors through the site shell and provide useful recovery actions.

findings.summary: The stylesheet is not writing-mode resilient.
findings.evidence: Pages declare zh or zh-TW, but CSS signal inspection found no logical inline/block properties and no dir declaration; layouts therefore depend on physical directions.
findings.suggestedFix: Use logical properties and set/derive dir so translated or bidi content can reflow safely.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bytes and lacks responsive formats.
findings.evidence: Images evidence found 13/13 legacy JPGs, 11 missing srcset, 13 missing dimensions, and 2 oversized; images transfer 376KB.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP responsive sources, size them to display needs, and reserve dimensions.

findings.summary: Background and autoplay work runs without user request.
findings.evidence: Source starts an autoplay carousel, a permanent 5-second interval, and third-party integrations on load; HAR records 16 third-party requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Stop autoplay under user preferences, pause work when hidden, and lazy-load non-essential third parties.

findings.summary: Third-party and decorative media cost is high relative to a text catalog.
findings.evidence: HAR totals 616KB, of which 239KB is third-party and 376KB is images; the largest request is a 143KB third-party script.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a text-site budget, defer third parties, and modernize decorative/cover image delivery.

taskList.title: Repair semantics, accessible names, contrast, headings, landmarks, and focus
Reserve and modernize every image asset
Deploy a complete browser security-header policy
Remove duplicate legacy jQuery/plugins and defer optional scripts
Add dark, reduced-motion, and increased-contrast preference support
Fix canonical, sitemap, crawlable-link, and entity metadata signals
Replace the custom drawer and carousel with semantic platform controls
Provide a branded, actionable HTTP error experience
Adopt modern responsive, navigation, and transition techniques
